concerns.text: The plan cites the model checkpoint `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-2-3B-4bit-gguf` as the source for extracting training‑side features (gradient norm, local curvature). This checkpoint is a 4‑bit quantized GGUF model, not a full‑precision FP16 model. Feature extraction must be performed on the full‑precision model state to satisfy FR‑001 and Principle VII (non‑circular feature‑target independence). Using a quantized model for gradient/curvature computation could invalidate the predictor’s training signals and break the hardware‑grounded validation requirement.
